values.note: Electric sites $30 a night; $10 non-refundable reservation fee per site per reservation. No vehicle entrance pass is needed: Fox Park is not part of the Menominee County Parks System.

note: Cedarville Township park on M-35 along the Bay of Green Bay: 10 acres with a picnic area and beach, about 29 miles north of Menominee. Not part of the Menominee County Parks system, though booked through its reservation site. One camper plus one tent (or two tents) per site. --Claude
